name: The Goblin
source:
"Blow out the candle. Look deep into your eyes.
Look long enough, and the boogeymen and goblins will come out to play..."

[From [url=https://swampsnail.itch.io/the-goblin]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“吹灭蜡烛。深深地看着你的眼睛。
看久了，妖怪和妖精就会出来玩……”

[来自[url=https://swampsnail.itch.io/the-goblin]Itch.io[/url]]
